description: Source code for managing server instances, signals, and plugin callbacks in a lighttpd-based server environment, including spawning, state management, and connection handling.

classes.name: liServer
classes.description: Represents the server instance, managing event loop, plugins, and signal handling.

classes.name: liInstance
classes.description: Represents a server worker instance, managing its state, process, and resources.

classes.name: liInstanceConf
classes.description: Configuration for creating a new instance, including command, environment, user, and resource limits.

classes.name: liInstanceResource
classes.description: Resources associated with an instance, with callback for freeing.

methods.name: li_server_new
methods.description: Creates a new server instance, initializing event loop and plugins.

methods.name: li_server_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the server.

methods.name: li_server_stop
methods.description: Stops the server's event loop and associated activities.

methods.name: li_server_new_instance
methods.description: Creates a new server worker instance based on configuration.

methods.name: li_instance_conf_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance configuration object.

methods.name: li_instance_conf_release
methods.description: Releases resources held by an instance configuration.

methods.name: li_instance_conf_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for an instance configuration.

methods.name: li_instance_set_state
methods.description: Sets the desired state for an instance, triggering spawn or control actions.

methods.name: li_instance_state_reached
methods.description: Handles logic when an instance reaches a specific state.

methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees an instance if no longer used.

methods.description: Increments reference count for an instance.
